quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the importance of vulnerability in leadership
quotes.excerpt: Being a leader is being comfortable with raising your hand like, I don't know, can you explain that?
quotes.quote: Being a leader is being comfortable with raising your hand like, I don't know, can you explain that to me? I don't know X, Y, and Z. I want to learn. Somebody being around somebody that feel like they know it all, I don't want to be around that person. I don't want to be the smartest person in the room. I want to learn from somebody else. So asking questions, being vulnerable, it is okay not to know something. It's not okay not to ask questions and not want to learn, because it's not how we're going to get better at anything in life, not just basketball. Whatever you want to do in life, you have to ask questions, you have to listen, you have to learn.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the importance of efficiency and fundamentals
quotes.excerpt: Efficiency, mindset, focus, discipline. Sometimes it's the little simple stuff that you just got to clean up.
quotes.quote: Efficiency, mindset, focus, discipline. Sometimes it's the little simple stuff that you just got to clean up. The complicated stuff will take care of itself, but some people are missing the simple stuff. Simple, one-dribble pull-ups, getting to your spot, footwork. So efficiency, that's the keyword for the summer.
